#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Alter sResults.vwResults to attach NHC + TrialCertificates as one aggregated
column each per placement row (OUTER APPLY / STRING_AGG — no Cartesian fan-out).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import pyodbc
from _remount_source_divisions import CONN

VIEW_SQL = r"""
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [sResults].[vwResults] AS
SELECT TOP 10000000
	l.Year,
	l.TrialName,
	l.StartDate,
	l.EndDate,
	dv.DivisionName,
	c.ClassName,
	d.DogName,
	ISNULL(d.Sire, 'Not Available') AS Sire,
	ISNULL(d.Dam, 'Not Available') AS Dam,
	ISNULL(anc.Grandsire, 'Not Available') AS Grandsire,
	ISNULL(anc.Granddam, 'Not Available') AS Granddam,
	ISNULL(anc.GreatGrandsire, 'Not Available') AS GreatGrandsire,
	ISNULL(anc.GreatGranddam, 'Not Available') AS GreatGranddam,
	ISNULL(ss.Sibling, 'Not Available') AS Sibling,
	o.OwnerName,
	COALESCE(bo.OwnerName, br.OwnerName) AS BreederOwnerName,
	COALESCE(bo.City, br.City) AS BreederCity,
	COALESCE(bo.State, br.State) AS BreederState,
	COALESCE(bo.Email, br.Email) AS BreederEmail,
	COALESCE(bo.Phone, br.Phone) AS BreederPhone,
	COALESCE(bo.Website, br.Website) AS BreederWebsite,
	p.Result,
	p.Heat,
	p.Qtr,
	p.Semi,
	tc.EntryCount,
	pt.Time,
	nhc.NHC AS NHC,
	tcert.TrialCertificates AS TrialCertificates
FROM [TrialResults].[sResults].[TrialPlacements] (NOLOCK) p
JOIN [TrialResults].[sResults].[TrialList] (NOLOCK) l ON p.TrialListID = l.TrialListID
JOIN [TrialResults].[sResults].[TrialClass] (NOLOCK) tc ON p.TrialClassID = tc.TrialClassID
JOIN [TrialResults].[sResults].[Class] (NOLOCK) c ON tc.ClassID = c.ClassID
JOIN [TrialResults].[sResults].[Division] (NOLOCK) dv ON c.DivisionID = dv.DivisionID
JOIN [TrialResults].[sResults].[Dog] (NOLOCK) d ON p.DogID = d.DogID
LEFT JOIN [TrialResults].[sResults].[Owner] (NOLOCK) o ON d.OwnerID = o.OwnerID
LEFT JOIN [TrialResults].[sResults].[Breeder] (NOLOCK) br ON d.BreederID = br.BreederID
OUTER APPLY (
	SELECT TOP 1 o2.OwnerName, o2.City, o2.State, o2.Email, o2.Phone, o2.Website
	FROM [TrialResults].[sResults].[Owner] (NOLOCK) o2
	WHERE d.BreederID IS NOT NULL
	  AND o2.BreederID = d.BreederID
	ORDER BY o2.OwnerID
) bo
LEFT JOIN [TrialResults].[sResults].[TrialPlacements_Times] (NOLOCK) pt
	ON p.TrialPlacementsID = pt.TrialPlacementsID
OUTER APPLY (
	SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST(ss.RelatedDogName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), ', ') AS Sibling
	FROM (
		(
			SELECT DISTINCT ss.RelatedDogName
			FROM [TrialResults].[sResults].[Relationship] ss (NOLOCK)
			WHERE d.DogID = ss.DogID
			  AND ISNULL(ss.RelationshipType, '') = 'Sibling'
		)
		UNION
		SELECT DISTINCT ss.RelatedDogName + ' (half)'
		FROM [TrialResults].[sResults].[Relationship] ss (NOLOCK)
		WHERE d.DogID = ss.DogID
		  AND ISNULL(ss.RelationshipType, '') LIKE '%Half%Sibling%'
	) ss
) ss
OUTER APPLY (
	SELECT
		STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN a.Kind = N'Grandsire' THEN a.RelatedDogName END, N', ')
			WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.RelatedDogName) AS Grandsire,
		STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN a.Kind = N'Granddam' THEN a.RelatedDogName END, N', ')
			WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.RelatedDogName) AS Granddam,
		STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN a.Kind = N'GreatGrandsire' THEN a.RelatedDogName END, N', ')
			WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.RelatedDogName) AS GreatGrandsire,
		STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN a.Kind = N'GreatGranddam' THEN a.RelatedDogName END, N', ')
			WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.RelatedDogName) AS GreatGranddam
	FROM (
		SELECT DISTINCT Kind, RelatedDogName
		FROM (
			SELECT N'Grandsire' AS Kind, sire.Sire AS RelatedDogName
			FROM [TrialResults].[sResults].[Dog] sire (NOLOCK)
			WHERE sire.DogName = d.Sire
			UNION
			SELECT N'Grandsire', dam.Sire
			FROM [TrialResults].[sResults].[Dog] dam (NOLOCK)
			WHERE dam.DogName = d.Dam
			UNION
			SELECT N'Granddam', sire.Dam
			FROM [TrialResults].[sResults].[Dog] sire (NOLOCK)
			WHERE sire.DogName = d.Sire
			UNION
			SELECT N'Granddam', dam.Dam
			FROM [TrialResults].[sResults].[Dog] dam (NOLOCK)
			WHERE dam.DogName = d.Dam
			UNION
			SELECT rel.RelationshipType, rel.RelatedDogName
			FROM [TrialResults].[sResults].[Relationship] rel (NOLOCK)
			WHERE rel.DogID = d.DogID
			  AND rel.RelationshipType IN (N'Grandsire', N'Granddam')
			UNION
			SELECT N'GreatGrandsire', gp.Sire
			FROM [TrialResults].[sResults].[Dog] parent (NOLOCK)
			JOIN [TrialResults].[sResults].[Dog] gp (NOLOCK)
				ON gp.DogName IN (parent.Sire, parent.Dam)
			WHERE parent.DogName IN (d.Sire, d.Dam)
			UNION
			SELECT N'GreatGranddam', gp.Dam
			FROM [TrialResults].[sResults].[Dog] parent (NOLOCK)
			JOIN [TrialResults].[sResults].[Dog] gp (NOLOCK)
				ON gp.DogName IN (parent.Sire, parent.Dam)
			WHERE parent.DogName IN (d.Sire, d.Dam)
			UNION
			SELECT CASE rel.RelationshipType
				WHEN N'Great-grandsire' THEN N'GreatGrandsire'
				WHEN N'Great-granddam' THEN N'GreatGranddam'
			END, rel.RelatedDogName
			FROM [TrialResults].[sResults].[Relationship] rel (NOLOCK)
			WHERE rel.DogID = d.DogID
			  AND rel.RelationshipType IN (N'Great-grandsire', N'Great-granddam')
		) raw
		WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(raw.RelatedDogName)), N'') IS NOT NULL
		  AND raw.RelatedDogName <> N'Not Available'
		  AND raw.Kind IS NOT NULL
	) a
) anc
-- One aggregated NHC string per dog (no row fan-out)
OUTER APPLY (
	SELECT STRING_AGG(x.Item, N' | ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x.SortYear, x.Item) AS NHC
	FROM (
		SELECT DISTINCT
			ISNULL(n.Year, 0) AS SortYear,
			CONCAT(
				ISNULL(CAST(n.Year AS nvarchar(10)), N'?'),
				N' ',
				ISNULL(n.CertificateType, N'NHC'),
				CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(n.Prey)), N'') IS NOT NULL
					THEN N' — ' + n.Prey ELSE N'' END,
				CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(n.JudgeName)), N'') IS NOT NULL
					THEN N' (Judge: ' + n.JudgeName + N')' ELSE N'' END
			) AS Item
		FROM [TrialResults].[sResults].[NHC] n (NOLOCK)
		WHERE (n.DogID IS NOT NULL AND n.DogID = d.DogID)
		   OR (n.DogID IS NULL AND n.DogName = d.DogName)
	) x
) nhc
-- One aggregated TrialCertificates string per dog (no row fan-out)
OUTER APPLY (
	SELECT STRING_AGG(x.Item, N' | ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x.SortYear, x.Item) AS TrialCertificates
	FROM (
		SELECT DISTINCT
			ISNULL(t.Year, 0) AS SortYear,
			CONCAT(
				ISNULL(CAST(t.Year AS nvarchar(10)), N'?'),
				N' ',
				ISNULL(t.CertificateType, N'Trial'),
				CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.TrialName)), N'') IS NOT NULL
					THEN N' @ ' + t.TrialName ELSE N'' END,
				CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.JudgeName)), N'') IS NOT NULL
					THEN N' (Judge: ' + t.JudgeName + N')' ELSE N'' END
			) AS Item
		FROM [TrialResults].[sResults].[TrialCertificates] t (NOLOCK)
		WHERE (t.DogID IS NOT NULL AND t.DogID = d.DogID)
		   OR (t.DogID IS NULL AND t.DogName = d.DogName)
	) x
) tcert
ORDER BY l.Year, l.StartDate, l.EndDate, l.TrialName, dv.DivisionName, c.ClassName, p.Result
"""


def main() -> None:
    cn = pyodbc.connect(CONN, timeout=120, autocommit=True)
    cur = cn.cursor()
    cur.execute("SET LOCK_TIMEOUT 60000")
    cur.execute("SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM sResults.vwResults")
    before = cur.fetchone()[0]
    print("before", before, flush=True)
    cur.execute(VIEW_SQL)
    print("view altered", flush=True)
    cur.execute("SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM sResults.vwResults")
    after = cur.fetchone()[0]
    print("after", after, flush=True)
    if before != after:
        raise SystemExit(f"ROW COUNT CHANGED {before} -> {after}")
    cur.execute(
        """
        SELECT TOP 5 DogName, NHC, TrialCertificates
        FROM sResults.vwResults
        WHERE NHC IS NOT NULL OR TrialCertificates IS NOT NULL
        """
    )
    for r in cur.fetchall():
        print(r[0])
        print("  NHC:", (r[1] or "")[:180])
        print("  TC :", (r[2] or "")[:180])
    cur.execute(
        """
        SELECT
          SUM(CASE WHEN NHC IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
          SUM(CASE WHEN TrialCertificates IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        FROM sResults.vwResults
        """
    )
    print("rows with NHC / TC:", cur.fetchone())
    cn.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def main() -> None:
    cn = pyodbc.connect(CONN, timeout=60)
    cur = cn.cursor()

    cur.execute(
        """
        SELECT TOP 20 d.DogID, d.DogName, d.BreederID, b.KennelName, b.KennelPrefix

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Enforce Dog.BreederID only when DogName starts with Breeder.KennelPrefix (exact prefix).

Rule: association requires DogName LIKE KennelPrefix + ' %' OR DogName = KennelPrefix
(case-insensitive). Prefer the longest matching KennelPrefix when several apply.
Wrong / spurious BreederIDs are cleared or corrected.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import re
from collections import defaultdict

import pyodbc
from _remount_source_divisions import CONN


def norm_prefix(s: str | None) -> str:
    s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", (s or "").strip())
    return s


def main() -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    cn = pyodbc.connect(CONN, timeout=120)
    cur = cn.cursor()

    # Load breeders with usable prefixes
    cur.execute(
        """
        SELECT BreederID,
               ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(KennelPrefix)), ''), KennelName) AS Prefix,
               KennelName, KennelPrefix
        FROM sResults.Breeder
        WHERE ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(KennelPrefix)), ''), KennelName) IS NOT NULL
          AND LEN(ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(KennelPrefix)), ''), KennelName)) >= 2
        """
    )
    breeders: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
    prefix_to_ids: dict[str, list[int]] = defaultdict(list)
    for bid, prefix, kname, kpref in cur.fetchall():
        p = norm_prefix(prefix)
        if len(p) < 2:
            continue
        breeders.append((int(bid), p))
        prefix_to_ids[p.casefold()].append(int(bid))

    # Longest prefix first for matching
    breeders.sort(key=lambda x: (-len(x[1]), x[1].casefold()))
    print(f"breeders with prefix: {len(breeders)}", flush=True)

    # All dogs that currently have a BreederID OR whose name might match a prefix
    cur.execute(
        """
        SELECT d.DogID, d.DogName, d.BreederID,
               ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.KennelPrefix)), ''), b.KennelName) AS CurPrefix
        FROM sResults.Dog d
        LEFT JOIN sResults.Breeder b ON b.BreederID = d.BreederID
        """
    )
    dogs = cur.fetchall()
    print(f"dogs scanned: {len(dogs)}", flush=True)

    def best_match(dog_name: str) -> tuple[int, str] | None:
        name = norm_prefix(dog_name)
        if not name:
            return None
        name_cf = name.casefold()
        for bid, pref in breeders:
            pref_cf = pref.casefold()
            if name_cf == pref_cf or name_cf.startswith(pref_cf + " "):
                return bid, pref
        return None

    clear: list[int] = []
    reassign: list[tuple[int, int, str, str]] = []  # dogid, new_bid, dogname, new_prefix
    ok = 0
    already_null_ok = 0

    examples_clear = []
    examples_reassign = []

    for dog_id, dog_name, cur_bid, cur_prefix in dogs:
        match = best_match(dog_name or "")
        if cur_bid is None:
            if match:
                # optional: could assign missing links — user asked to correct wrong/spurious
                # associations; also fill correct ones when name 100% matches a prefix
                reassign.append((int(dog_id), match[0], dog_name, match[1]))
                if len(examples_reassign) < 15:
                    examples_reassign.append(
                        (dog_name, None, cur_prefix, match[0], match[1])
                    )
            else:
                already_null_ok += 1
            continue

        cur_bid = int(cur_bid)
        cur_pref_n = norm_prefix(cur_prefix)
        name = norm_prefix(dog_name or "")
        name_cf = name.casefold()
        cur_ok = bool(
            cur_pref_n
            and (
                name_cf == cur_pref_n.casefold()
                or name_cf.startswith(cur_pref_n.casefold() + " ")
            )
        )

        if match is None:
            # has BreederID but no valid prefix match at all → clear
            clear.append(int(dog_id))
            if len(examples_clear) < 20:
                examples_clear.append((dog_name, cur_bid, cur_pref_n, None, None))
            continue

        new_bid, new_pref = match
        if cur_ok and cur_bid == new_bid:
            ok += 1
            continue
        if cur_ok and cur_bid != new_bid:
            # current prefix string matches name, but a longer/different breeder also matches
            # Prefer longest (already). If current prefix equals new_pref but different IDs
            # (duplicate breeders), keep current if same prefix text.
            if cur_pref_n.casefold() == new_pref.casefold():
                ok += 1
                continue
            # longer prefix won
            reassign.append((int(dog_id), new_bid, dog_name, new_pref))
            if len(examples_reassign) < 15:
                examples_reassign.append(
                    (dog_name, cur_bid, cur_pref_n, new_bid, new_pref)
                )
            continue

        # current association does NOT satisfy 100% prefix match
        if new_bid != cur_bid:
            reassign.append((int(dog_id), new_bid, dog_name, new_pref))
            if len(examples_reassign) < 15:
                examples_reassign.append(
                    (dog_name, cur_bid, cur_pref_n, new_bid, new_pref)
                )
        else:
            ok += 1

    print(f"ok={ok} clear={len(clear)} reassign={len(reassign)} null_ok={already_null_ok}", flush=True)
    print("=== clear examples (dog, old_bid, old_prefix)", flush=True)
    for e in examples_clear:
        print(" ", e, flush=True)
    print("=== reassign examples (dog, old_bid, old_prefix, new_bid, new_prefix)", flush=True)
    for e in examples_reassign:
        print(" ", e, flush=True)

    # Spotlight Blue River
    cur.execute(
        """
        SELECT d.DogID, d.DogName, d.BreederID, b.KennelPrefix
        FROM sResults.Dog d
        LEFT JOIN sResults.Breeder b ON b.BreederID = d.BreederID
        WHERE d.DogName LIKE 'Blue River%'
        """
    )
    print("=== Blue River before/planned", flush=True)
    for r in cur.fetchall():
        m = best_match(r[1])
        print(" ", tuple(r), "->", m, flush=True)

    if not args.apply:
        print("DRY-RUN (pass --apply to write)", flush=True)
        cn.rollback()
        cn.close()
        return

    # Apply clears
    batch = 500
    for i in range(0, len(clear), batch):
        chunk = clear[i : i + batch]
        cur.execute(
            f"""
            UPDATE sResults.Dog
            SET BreederID = NULL
            WHERE DogID IN ({",".join("?" for _ in chunk)})
            """,
            chunk,
        )
    # Apply reassigns
    for i in range(0, len(reassign), batch):
        chunk = reassign[i : i + batch]
        # update one-by-one is safer for mixed new ids; executemany
        cur.fast_executemany = True
        cur.executemany(
            "UPDATE sResults.Dog SET BreederID=? WHERE DogID=?",
            [(bid, did) for did, bid, _n, _p in chunk],
        )

    cn.commit()
    print("COMMITTED", flush=True)

    cur.execute(
        """
        SELECT d.DogID, d.DogName, d.BreederID, b.KennelPrefix, b.KennelName
        FROM sResults.Dog d
        LEFT JOIN sResults.Breeder b ON b.BreederID = d.BreederID
        WHERE d.DogName LIKE 'Blue River%'
        ORDER BY d.DogName
        """
    )
    print("=== Blue River after", flush=True)
    for r in cur.fetchall():
        print(" ", tuple(r), flush=True)

    # Verify: no remaining dogs with BreederID whose name doesn't start with that prefix
    cur.execute(
        """
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM sResults.Dog d
        JOIN sResults.Breeder b ON b.BreederID = d.BreederID
        WHERE NOT (
          d.DogName = ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.KennelPrefix)), ''), b.KennelName)
          OR d.DogName LIKE ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.KennelPrefix)), ''), b.KennelName) + ' %'
        )
        COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI
        """
    )
    print("remaining mismatches", cur.fetchone()[0], flush=True)
    cn.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
